note: 자주 묻는 SPARQL 구조. 슬롯 <<NAME>> 에는 IRI 만 들어간다. slots: class | property | instance.

templates.sparql:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?s ?label WHERE { ?s rdf:type <<CLASS>> . OPTIONAL { ?s rdfs:label ?label } } LIMIT 100

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?sub WHERE { ?sub rdfs:subClassOf <<CLASS>> } LIMIT 100

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?sup WHERE { <<CLASS>> rdfs:subClassOf+ ?sup } LIMIT 100

questions: Y 는 어떤 클래스 사이를 잇나
domain and range of a property
templates.sparql:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?d ?r WHERE { <<PROPERTY>> rdfs:domain ?d . OPTIONAL { <<PROPERTY>> rdfs:range ?r } }

questions: X 가 가질 수 있는 속성
